notes.title: The game as been released!!
notes.notes: Get ready for the ultimate test of speed and precision with The Orange! Simple, addictive, and endlessly satisfying—this game is all about pressing and clicking as many oranges as you can! Perfect for quick breaks or long gaming sessions, it’s a challenge you won’t want to put down. Think you have what it takes? Visit our shop now and start clicking your way to the top!
